agents.client_type_hint: For example claude-code or cursor. Optional.
agents.disable_hint: Disabling an agent revokes every credential it holds.
agents.intro: Register the AI agents that may connect to this workspace and issue their tokens.
agents.name: Name
agents.tier_change_hint: Changes what a new or existing token may do.

tier_hints.read_only: May read and search, and propose nothing.
tier_hints.propose: May propose changes; every write is reviewed.
tier_hints.trusted: May write directly where a policy rule allows it; otherwise reviewed.

agents.title: Agents
agents.token_once: Copy this token now. It is shown once and cannot be recovered.

taxonomy.aliases_hint: Separated by commas. Used when matching a category by name.
taxonomy.guidance_hint: One line per point. Shown to agents deciding where something belongs.
taxonomy.intro: The curated category tree of this workspace.
taxonomy.name: Name
taxonomy.name_hint: The identifier is derived from the name.
taxonomy.parent_hint: Moving a category takes everything under it along.
taxonomy.slug_hint: The path segment. Changing it moves this category and everything under it.
taxonomy.title: Taxonomy

policy.actor_id_hint: The actor id, as the agents and members lists show it.

effect_hints.deny: The write is refused and no proposal is created.
effect_hints.allow_direct: The write is applied without review. This is approval given in advance.
effect_hints.require_review: The write becomes a proposal and waits for a reviewer.

policy.empty: No rules yet. Every agent write waits for review.
policy.form_intro: Without a rule that allows a write directly, every agent write waits for a reviewer, including a trusted one.
policy.intro: Rules decide whether a permitted write is applied directly or waits for review.
policy.priority_hint: Lower numbers are considered first. The first matching rule decides.
policy.subject: Applies to
policy.title: Policy rules

settings.language_hint: Remembered in this browser. Choosing it in your profile arrives with profile editing.
settings.password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

workspace.add_member_intro: Add an existing account by email, or create one by giving it a password to pass on.
workspace.default_language_hint: Used for knowledge items that do not state their own language.
workspace.display_name_hint: Only used when creating a new account.
workspace.initial_password_hint: Required for a new account. Ask the person to change it after signing in.
